name: credentialedScanCoveragePercentage
definition: The percentage of in-scope assets that the scanner assessed with authenticated (credentialed) access rather than unauthenticated probing.
population: every non-deprecated asset the scanner lists for one company (the passport's); a read whose rows span more than one company_id, or a row with none, is not measured; denominator = that count of assets
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete read of every active asset of one company, each carrying a true or false authenticated-scan flag; 100 only when every one is true.
citations: ConnectSecure public Swagger, GET /r/asset/asset_view: <pod>/apidocs/swagger.yaml (each vendor pod publishes it), see https://cybercns.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CVB/pages/2128314664/V4+API+Information (read 2026-10-12)

changeLog.change: Registered so the ConnectSecure transforms can emit it. The meaning is the catalogue description made precise; unverified fields are named in the transform docstring.

notes: Registered for the ConnectSecure transforms. Other vendors' transforms already emit this key (Intruder, Rapid7, Action1, Amazon Inspector); whether they measure the same population was not reviewed, so the key stays proposed and V0 and the owner is not yet named.
